title: OverlayManifest
description: Manifest for a translation / parish / jurisdiction overlay under `fixed-texts/translations/<id>/manifest.json`. Drives the cascade order (parent-first via `extends`) and surfaces metadata to the picker UI via `/api/translations`. Validated at server boot by `validateManifest` in `server.js`; this schema is the documentation contract that mirrors that runtime validator.

name.description: Human-readable label shown in the settings picker. Example: 'St. Tikhon's Sluzhebnik (OCA)', 'Holy Transfiguration Monastery, Boston'.

kind.description: `tradition` = cross-jurisdictional translation lineage (HTM-Boston, Hapgood, Jordanville). `parish` = local customization layered on a tradition. `jurisdiction` = jurisdiction-wide curated default stack (OCA, ROCOR, Antiochian); typically empty `liturgy-fixed.json` plus an `extends` chain pointing at the canonical tradition for that jurisdiction. Selected via the jurisdiction pill in the settings picker.

jurisdiction.description: Canonical jurisdiction tag used for picker filtering. `null` for cross-jurisdictional overlays (e.g. HTM-Boston). Mirrors `ALLOWED_JURISDICTIONS` in `server.js`.

style.description: Calendar style this overlay implies. `new` = Revised Julian (most OCA/GOA/Antiochian); `old` = Julian fixed feasts (ROCOR, traditionalist parishes). Omit to inherit from the extends chain / base.

extends.description: Parent overlay ids; applied parent-first, depth-first, then this overlay on top. Use `[]` (or omit) to layer only over the base fixed-text file. Cycle detection warns and skips the cyclic edge.

description.description: One-line summary shown in the picker meta row. Plain prose.

sources.description: Provenance — the book, edition, ISBN, or URL the overlay's text was drawn from. Carries forward to STYLE.md §5 traceability.

rubrics.description: Non-text rubrical preferences that adjust assembler branching without changing any text. Merged across the extends chain (child wins). Mirrors validation in `server.js#validateManifest` rubrics branch.

omitCatechumensSeasons.description: Liturgical seasons during which the Litany of the Catechumens is omitted at this parish. Example: ['brightWeek', 'pentecostarion'].

examples.name: St. Tikhon's Sluzhebnik (OCA)
examples.description: St. Tikhon's Seminary Press priestly service book (2nd ed., 2010).
examples.sources: Service Books of the Orthodox Church, St. Tikhon's Seminary Press, 2010 (ISBN 978-1-878997-86-9).

examples.name: St. John of Damascus, Tyler, TX
examples.description: Local customizations layered over the OCA's St. Tikhon's Sluzhebnik.
